about: NTC Industries Ltd is the listed parent of a Kolkata group which manufactures cigarettes /smoking mixture, trading F&B /other FMCG products and letting properties through 4 wholly owned subsidiaries. It traces its operating heritage to National Tobacco Company of India (1931). [1] [2] [3]
